title: Stop Doing This When Your Engine Overheats
hook: Stop opening your hot radiator cap.

script.narration: Stop opening your hot radiator cap.
Doing this releases pressurized boiling coolant instantly. It can cause severe burns to your face and hands.
Always wait at least thirty minutes for the engine to cool down completely before touching it.
Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Have you ever checked your coolant? Comment yes or no. Stop opening your hot radiator cap.
